source_title: Dax Shepard Says Raising Teens with Wife Kristen Bell Has Been a ‘Stressor’ in Their Marriage - People.com
source_excerpt:
The ‘Parenthood’ alum shares his two daughters Lincoln, 13, and Delta, 11, with Bell
Dax Shepard admitted that raising teens has added stress to his marriage with Kristen Bell
The actor says he and Bell sometimes disagree on parenting but do not scream or swear at each other
The couple share daughters Lincoln, 13, and Delta, 11
Dax Shepard is opening up about raising his two teenage daughters with wife Kristen Bell .
On a Wednesday, Oct. 28 episode of his podcast Armchair Expert , the actor, 51, was asked by Erin and Sara Foster whether he and Bell ever get into fights. He shared that the two, who are parents to daughters Lincoln, 13, and Delta, 11, are “pretty good at handling our s--t” after 19 years together.
“We have a lot of s---t though,” Shepard said. “We have two children, and they are going through puberty, and that stressor...it throws the whole dynamic into a new zone that you have to figure out. ‘Okay, how do we now navigate this?’”
“You know, it’s really hard when they’re really little because you care so much about the decisions you’re making with the kid,” he shared. “You’re certain you can f--k it up.”

While he admitted that he and Bell will sometimes “butt heads” over how to handle a specific situation with their two kids, the two aren’t screaming or swearing at each other.
“And then there’s a sweet spot between, like, six and puberty,” said Shepard. “You’re like, ‘This is working out pretty good. I think this compromise, however we’re doing it, is working.’ And then a whole new situation comes, and you’re like, ‘F--k. Well now we need a new strategy, and I don’t know that we always agree.’”
“And then there’s more stress. I like to think if we didn’t have kids, it would be pretty smooth sailing,” he explained. “But we don’t scream at each other or swear at each other.”
However, Shepard said that he and Bell will occasionally put off their more important conversations about their daughters.
“We’ll kick something down the road for a week,” he said. “We’ll go to bed for a week where it’s like, we’re gonna have to talk about this eventually. You know, what day will it be? When will there be enough free air in the f--king room without the kids to mount this?”
Back in August, Shepard shared a carousel of photos on Instagram from his family’s trip to a lake in Tennessee , including a rare look at his two daughters. The actor could be seen driving a boat on the water in one clip.
As the video panned out, his two daughters were pictured sitting at the front of the boat. One of the girls had her hair in a bun, while the other had French braids. “Dream summer ❤️❤️❤️❤️,” Shepard captioned the post.
